XBOX360UCSC_FINALS (XTAF)

Documentation date: 2014-04-30.

This directory contains two disk images of XBox 360 hard drives.

The drives are 250GB, and were packaged with two XBox 360 "Slim" consoles.  They were populated with actions taken with the standard console user interface.  Time 0 is as they were packaged, Final is after deleting accounts at the experiments' conclusion.

No modifications to the drive contents were done at any time outside of their original XBox 360 console.

Multiple accounts interacted with one another through XBox Live, Gold membership paid for with prepaid debit cards or payment codes.  Some of these accounts were used to play the titles "Fallout 3" for single-player artifacts and "Halo 3: ODST" for multi-player artifacts.  Multi-player games were done by invitation restricted to accounts listed in this document.

Search strings for gaming and gamer information are included in this document.  Most generated strings were derived from the Wikipedia list of dinosaurs, selected for being fairly distinct natural-language strings unlikely to appear in game or web browsing content.  XBox Live gamertag names were automatically generated by the Live service, except for "Forum" which was a manual rename.

Regarding payments:  The ends of debit card numbers input to the console are also provided, equivalent to what one would find on a discarded receipt.  The card balances have been zeroed.  By our experience, and reported console design, these numbers do not and should not appear on the console.  If you are able to discover their presence, we---and probably Microsoft---would be very interested to hear your methodology.

Regarding format:  The disk images are supplied in the EnCase Expert Witness Format.  For these data, time stamps specific to the EWF format do not necessarily reflect the time a disk was imaged, and may instead reflect the time the image was converted from an alternative image format.

Regarding drive numbering:  DRIVE1 was an uncontrolled experimental image.  That is why the drive numbers start at 2.

Questions about these data should be directed to: ajnelson@cs.ucsc.edu.

This narrative may be updated to address asked questions.  Please include the date when referring to the narrative.
